QuestionStmt.S: Which of the following molecules consist minimum lone pair of electrons in the valence shell of central atom?

Solution.S:
The number of lone pairs on the central atom in each molecule is:

- $\mathrm{SCl_2}$: S has 2 lone pairs
- $\mathrm{PCl_3}$: P has 1 lone pair
- $\mathrm{ClF_3}$: Cl has 2 lone pairs
- $\mathrm{XeF_4}$: Xe has 2 lone pairs

Thus, $\mathrm{PCl_3}$ has the minimum number of lone pairs (1) on the central atom.

Hence, the correct option is B.
